purpose: Frozen authored development-regression questions; not an independent benchmark, legal-quality score, or exhaustive real-contract ground truth.
review_basis: Labels checked against authored fixture text, physical-page PDF extraction and representative rendered pages. Unanswerable labels are source-review judgments over this finite corpus, not substring proofs of absence.

nda_return.quote: The confidentiality obligation survives for two years after the discussions end.

service_payment.quote: Invoices are payable within 30 days of receipt.

service_schedule_payment.quote: Each invoice is payable within 7 days of receipt.

service_acceptance.quote: Example Supplier will correct an identified failure and resubmit the deliverable.

service_termination.quote: Either party may end it with 14 days of written notice.

service_liability.quote: Example Supplier's total liability is limited to fees paid under this agreement.

embedded_return.quote: Example Supplier must return project material within five business days after termination.

consulting_acceptance.quote: Silence does not count as acceptance.

consulting_reusable.quote: Example Customer receives a continuing, non-exclusive licence to use and modify it for internal purposes.

consulting_material.quote: Example Supplier must keep supplied material separate from unrelated work and must not upload it to an external analysis service without Example Customer's prior written approval.

consulting_liability.quote: Each party's aggregate liability arising from the engagement is limited to GBP 9,600.

software_access.quote: Staff and temporary contractors may use the service while acting for Example Customer and following its instructions.

software_payment.quote: Unless an express schedule override applies, invoices are payable within 30 days of receipt.

software_credits.quote: Credits are not an exclusive remedy for every kind of service failure.

software_material.quote: Example Supplier must not sell that material, use it to advertise to unrelated businesses or include it in a general training dataset.

software_incident.quote: Example Supplier will notify Example Customer without undue delay after confirming such an incident and provide the information then reasonably available.

software_liability.quote: Each party's aggregate liability arising from this agreement is limited to the subscription charges paid or payable for the preceding twelve months.

software_renewal.quote: If the reminder is late, Example Customer may decline renewal until fifteen days after receiving it, even if the ordinary notice deadline has passed.

software_failure_exit.quote: Example Customer may also end it after the availability target is missed in three consecutive months, provided notice is given within thirty days after the third month.

software_payment_override.quote: For invoices issued under this initial order, payment is due within 14 days of receipt, not the ordinary thirty-day period.

managed_credit_ceiling.quote: Credit percentages are calculated against the monthly charge allocated to the affected item, subject to the ordinary ceiling of ten percent unless the express pilot exception applies.

managed_standard_exit.quote: Following notice of expiry or termination, Example Supplier will provide reasonable transition assistance for up to sixty days after the effective end date, subject to the agreed transition plan and approved assistance charges.

managed_disputed_export.quote: An unresolved invoice dispute does not permit withholding the only usable export of customer content.

managed_pilot_credit.quote: During the defined Archive pilot, the monthly service credit ceiling for the Archive Service is twenty percent of its allocated monthly charge rather than the ordinary ten percent ceiling in clause 45.

managed_pilot_price.quote: The Archive recurring charge is reduced by twenty five percent during the same defined pilot, giving a full pilot month charge of GBP 300 instead of GBP 400 before any service credit.

managed_archive_exit.quote: provided Example Customer requests the extension in its exit notice or within ten business days afterward.

managed_export_defect.quote: Approved assistance charges remain payable for new work, but correcting an export defect caused by Example Supplier's failure to meet the agreed format is not separately chargeable.

cases.query: Express payment override for the initial software order
cases.rationale: Locate the named initial-order override, not the ordinary payment clause alone.

cases.query: Archive transition extension exit notice ten business days
cases.rationale: The extension trigger belongs to the Archive amendment.

cases.query: Silence does not count as acceptance
cases.rationale: Exact phrase distinguishes consulting from software deemed acceptance.

cases.query: Archive recurring charge GBP 300 instead of GBP 400
cases.rationale: The pilot pricing exception contains the exact amounts and scope.

cases.query: confidentiality obligation survives for two years after the discussions end
cases.rationale: Two-year NDA survival must not be confused with three-year contract duties.

cases.query: When does the inventory application provider have to tell us about a confirmed break-in affecting our records?
cases.rationale: Semantic paraphrase of confirmed unauthorized access and incident notification.

cases.query: Can the consultant feed our project files into a third-party analysis tool without asking us first?
cases.rationale: External analysis requires prior written approval, not merely a confidentiality duty.

cases.query: Can the managed service provider hold our only usable data handover hostage over a contested bill?
cases.rationale: The exit provision explicitly separates an invoice dispute from the usable export.

cases.query: If the inventory software renewal reminder arrives too late, do we get extra time to opt out?
cases.rationale: The late-reminder exception qualifies the ordinary notice deadline.

cases.query: In the addendum containing planted instructions, how soon must the supplier hand back project material after the work ends?
cases.rationale: Retrieve the actual return duty; embedded instruction text remains untrusted source data.

cases.query: Find the written notice provisions for ending mutual confidentiality discussions and the two-page inventory engagement.
cases.rationale: Requires two distinct agreements; the NDA has no numeric notice period.

cases.query: Find the consulting material-separation duty and the software prohibition on putting customer material in a general training dataset.
cases.rationale: Both named processing restrictions are required, with different source identities.

cases.query: Find export-defect correction charges in managed services and the supplier resubmission duty in the two-page service terms.
cases.rationale: A generic correction passage from another agreement cannot replace either named duty.

cases.query: Find staff access rights in the software subscription and the internal-use reusable-material licence in consulting.
cases.rationale: Separate staff access from retained reusable-material licensing.

cases.query: Find liability caps in the two-page service terms, consulting engagement and inventory software subscription.
cases.rationale: All three specified agreements are relevant; a cap elsewhere is a near-match, not a substitute.

cases.query: Where do the 30-day and 7-day invoice deadlines conflict in the two-page service agreement?
cases.rationale: Both inconsistent clauses matter; unlike the software order, this source has no express priority rule.

cases.query: Find the software agreement's ordinary payment deadline and the initial order's express override.
cases.rationale: Retrieve the rule and actual exception; the short service deadline conflict is a distractor.

cases.query: Find the ordinary monthly service credit ceiling and the Archive pilot ceiling exception.
cases.rationale: Ten-percent ordinary and twenty-percent Archive-only ceilings are separate relevant passages.

cases.query: Find the standard managed-services transition assistance duration and the conditional Archive-only extension.
cases.rationale: The 120-day maximum qualifies the 60-day default rather than adding to it.

cases.query: Find software availability service credits and the separate right to end the subscription after repeated monthly failures.
cases.rationale: Credit entitlement does not replace the repeated-failure termination conditions.

cases.query: Which contract guarantees a dedicated GPU with 80GB VRAM?
cases.rationale: No fixture contracts for GPU hardware or that capacity; general service capacity is not responsive.

cases.query: What is the agreed Bitcoin wallet address for payment?
cases.rationale: These fixtures contain no cryptocurrency wallet or Bitcoin payment instruction. Generic payment terms are distractors.

cases.query: Find arbitration under Singapore International Arbitration Centre rules.
cases.rationale: No fixture chooses that institution or its rules; generic dispute discussions do not answer the query.

cases.query: What employee parental leave entitlement is agreed?
cases.rationale: The fixture corpus contains no employee parental leave entitlement; personnel obligations are not equivalent.
